description: Structured Facebook group directory + per-group posting checklist (SQLite-backed; the single source of truth that replaces the free-text seed-queue). Actions: worklist {currency|region, offerSlug, limit?, freshDays?=14, includePending?=false, reset?} — returns the groups STILL to post to for this offer: joined, promo not forbidden, region/currency match, not pending/cooldown, not already posted for this offer within freshDays; never-posted first, then least-recently-posted, then largest. Re-call it to RESUME (it returns only what is left); a new offerSlug (or reset:true) starts FRESH. mark {url, offerSlug, currency, status, postUrl?, note?} — record ONE group right after posting (durable checklist; call after EACH group, never batch). status posted=visible-post, pending=pending-approval (success; engages a 48h cooldown so the worklist skips it), failed=posting-failed, skipped. import {fromMemoryIds?, fromExtract?} — (re)build the directory from the surviving memories and/or a live browser_extract_fb_groups payload (idempotent). set {url | groups:[…]} with region/lang/currency/country/name/member_count/allows_promo — curation: authoritatively classify one or many groups (currency must be a SUPPORTED deal currency: USD/GBP/EUR/BRL/TRY/CAD/AUD). exclude {url, reason} — mark a group promo-forbidden (permanently dropped from worklists). list/stats {region?} — coverage counts by region, pending/cooldown, last-posted per offer. recategorize {} — one-shot cleanup: re-derive region/lang/currency/country for every group from name + post history and backfill allows_promo from confirmed visible posts (idempotent). Region buckets: UK, US, EU, Brazil, LatAm, Turkey, Australia, Canada, Unknown.

action.description: worklist: ordered groups still to post to (region/currency + offerSlug). mark: tick one group after posting. set: curate classification (region/lang/currency) for one or many groups. import: (re)build the directory from memories + a live extract. exclude: forbid promo in a group. list/stats: coverage. recategorize: re-derive region/lang/currency for every group and backfill allows_promo from history.

cooldownHours.description: mark: hours a pending-approval group is held out of the worklist (default 48).

country.description: descriptive country label. set: classify a group. worklist: narrow to one country.

currency.description: GBP | USD | EUR | BRL | TRY | AUD | CAD. Preferred worklist filter (authoritative seed-queue currency). USD covers both US and LatAm — add lang:"es" to target LatAm groups specifically.

freshDays.description: worklist: skip groups already posted this offer within N days (default 14).

fromExtract.description: import: a browser_extract_fb_groups JSON payload (object or JSON string) — the authority for currently-joined groups + region buckets.

fromMemoryIds.description: import: specific memory ids to parse. Omit to use the default seed/ledger ids + facebook-groups-* subcategory scan.

groups.description: set (bulk): array of group classifications to write in one call.

includePending.description: worklist: include pending-approval / cooldown groups (default false).

lang.description: language code (pt/en/de/fr/es/tr/pl/it/nl). set: classify a group. worklist: narrow a currency bucket to one language (e.g. EUR + de for German-copy groups).

note.description: mark: short note (e.g. skip reason or failure detail).

offerSlug.description: Offer/campaign slug, e.g. "spring-sale". Required for worklist and mark.

postUrl.description: mark: the resulting post URL, if known.

reason.description: exclude: why promo is forbidden (group rules).

region.description: UK | US | EU | Brazil | LatAm | Turkey | Australia | Canada | Unknown (case-insensitive). Alternative to currency for worklist/list/stats. LatAm = Spanish-speaking Latin America (posts the USD link).

reset.description: worklist: ignore prior posts for this offer (re-seed the whole region from scratch).

status.description: mark status: posted/visible-post, pending/pending-approval (cooldown 48h, counts as success), failed/posting-failed, or skipped. Synonyms accepted.

url.description: Group URL (normalized internally). Required for mark and exclude.

name: fb_groups
